name: Andouille Sausage
siboNotes: Pure andouille sausage is typically low FODMAP, but check labels for garlic, onion powder, or high FODMAP fillers which are common in commercial varieties.
preparationTips: Read ingredient labels carefully - avoid products with garlic or onion
Look for brands that use garlic-infused oil instead of garlic powder
Pan-fry or grill to render fat and enhance smoky flavor
Remove casings if sensitive to texture or additives
